name: cloudmentor-backend
description: AWS Lambda backend for CloudMentor with S3 uploads

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch template.yaml --watch env.json --watch package.json --watch package-lock.json --ext mjs,json,yaml,yml --ignore .aws-sam --exec "sam build && sam local start-api --warm-containers EAGER --env-vars env.json"
scripts.check: node --check src/app.mjs && node --check src/prompts.mjs && node --check src/config/runtime.mjs && node --check src/lib/http.mjs && node --check src/lib/files.mjs && node --check src/services/ai.mjs && node --check src/services/history.mjs && node --check src/services/uploads.mjs
